resources.string: Export the full song with the mix you have right now and share it with the group.
Preserves volumes, mute/solo, pan, master, tempo, pitch, Click, and the original Guide when active. Multichannel outputs are folded down to stereo.
Stop playback before exporting. StageGrid reserves CPU for live audio.
The exported file is no longer available. Generate it again.
Export uses the full linear song and does not include manual section jumps or Arrangement changes performed during playback.
Cue Auto is selected: the original Guide stays out of the file. Dynamic Cue Auto announcements are not baked into this linear export yet.
